result.brief: 提出 Bridge-of-Experts，用 32 个潜在桥接查询聚合视觉、语言与本体先验，联合视频-动作监督使视频专家表征更适配动作预测，并解耦专家深度实现轻量动作头。
result.reason: Couples video and action experts via shared latent bridge queries with joint video-action supervision, adapting video representations for action prediction—a world-action model representation contribution.
